recent_en: In September 2026, Winstar Capital proposed a sukuk programme of up to RM300 million to fund investments, land acquisition and refinancing, with MARC assigning a preliminary AIS rating. The latest quarter ended 30 September 2026 showed revenue and net profit rising quarter-on-quarter, with net profit up about 25% year-on-year. There were also multiple changes in directors' and substantial shareholders' interests, including share acquisitions by the CEO and an indirect disposal by a non-independent non-executive director.
notable_en: Proposed a sukuk programme of up to RM300 million to fund investments, land acquisition and refinancing.
Quarter ended 30 September 2026: revenue rose 36.6% QoQ and net profit rose 39.0% QoQ.
CEO Chua Boon Hong acquired 3,121,300 shares (1.000%) directly on 9 October 2026.
risks_en: Non-independent non-executive director Chow Kian Hung indirectly disposed of 31,860,834 shares (10.207%) on 9 October 2026.
Chow Kian Hung further indirectly disposed of 4,651,200 shares (1.490%) on 13 November 2026.
Fabulous Sunview's indirect stake in Winstar fell to 10.74% after the disposal of 4.65 million shares.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 81,417,000, up 36.6% QoQ and 33.1% YoY; net profit was MYR 3,689,000, up 39.0% QoQ and 3.4% YoY; net margin was 4.5%.
